keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Lazio 0, Cagliari 1. M'Bala Nzola (Cagliari) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Alieu Fadera following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Alieu Fadera (Cagliari).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cagliari. Raphael Kofler replaces Alieu Fadera because of an injury.
Goal! Lazio 1, Cagliari 1. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Tijjani Noslin.
First Half ends, Lazio 1, Cagliari 1.
Substitution, Cagliari. Paul Mendy replaces M'Bala Nzola.
Second Half begins Lazio 1, Cagliari 1.
Substitution, Lazio. Alfonso Pedraza replaces Nuno Tavares.
Substitution, Lazio. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru replaces Davide Frattesi.
Substitution, Lazio. Andrea Pinamonti replaces Mattia Zaccagni because of an injury.
Jacopo Fazzini (Cagliari) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Cagliari. Yael Trepy replaces Daniel Maldini.
Substitution, Cagliari. Joseph Liteta replaces Jacopo Fazzini.
Juan Rodríguez (Cagliari) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lazio. Diogo Leite replaces Oliver Provstgaard.
Adam Obert (Cagliari) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lazio. Danilo Cataldi replaces Reda Belahyane.
Goal! Lazio 2, Cagliari 1. Andrea Pinamonti (Lazio) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Alfonso Pedraza.
Andrea Pinamonti (Lazio) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Delay in match because of an injury Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cagliari. Kevin Carlos replaces Alessandro Deiola because of an injury.
Second yellow card to Adam Obert (Cagliari) for a bad foul.
